content.value: A simple calculator can only perform addition and subtraction of 2 numbers, but it (18) [CO3] can work in 2 modes – normal mode and complex mode. In the complex mode, a complex number is represented by 2 consecutive real numbers. Normal operations are defined in “normal. c” and for complex operations “complex . c". "main. c” file includes only “main. h". Design all the necessary C files and header files for the program.
(Answer ANY THREE questions from this section in Script B)
